meta.title: 闪光灯人像最好上手的方法
meta.title_en: The Easiest Way to Shoot Portraits with Flash

scenes.title_cn: 开场：今天分享闪光灯人像最好上手的一…
scenes.title_en: Opening: today, the easiest way to shoot f…
scenes.context: 给新手一条低门槛路径。
sentences: 今天分享闪光灯人像最好上手的一个方法。
Today, the easiest way to shoot flash portraits.
easiest method（最好上手）
买回来发现不会用，最后只能落灰。
They buy it, can't use it, and it gathers dust.
gathers dust（落灰）
这个方法的门槛很低，零基础也能学会。
The bar is low—total beginners can learn it.
low bar（门槛低）
scenes.speak: Today, the easiest way to shoot flash portraits. They buy it, can't use it, and it gathers dust. The bar is low—total beginners can learn it.

scenes.title_cn: 第一步·调整机身设置：先把相机的M档…
scenes.title_en: Step one · set the camera: turn on manual …
scenes.context: 先让环境光欠曝成黑场。
sentences: 先把相机的M档打开。
Turn on manual mode.
manual mode（M档）
快门速度设为1/200秒，ISO设为最低，光圈根据景深效果来定。
Shutter 1/200s, ISO minimum, aperture by the depth you want.
baseline settings（基准参数）
对着白墙拍一张测光照片，确保画面是黑色的。
Shoot a test frame at a white wall, making sure it's black.
make it black（压成黑场）
scenes.speak: Turn on manual mode. Shutter 1/200s, ISO minimum, aperture by the depth you want. Shoot a test frame at a white wall, making sure it's black.

scenes.title_cn: 第二步·调整闪光灯：闪光灯设置为TT…
scenes.title_en: Step two · set the flash: put the flash in…
sentences: 闪光灯设置为TTL模式。
Set the flash to TTL mode.
TTL mode（自动测光）
站在你计划的拍摄位置，对着被摄主体拍一张测试照。
Stand at your planned spot and shoot a test frame at the subject.
test frame（测试照）
太暗就把闪光灯补偿调高，太亮就调低。
Too dark, raise flash compensation; too bright, lower it.
flash compensation（闪光补偿）
scenes.speak: Set the flash to TTL mode. Stand at your planned spot and shoot a test frame at the subject. Too dark, raise flash compensation; too bright, lower it.

scenes.title_cn: 第三步·简单后期：拍完导入电脑后，照…
scenes.title_en: Step three · simple post: after importing,…
sentences: 照片整体色调偏灰是正常现象，因为环境光被压掉了。
The image looks gray because ambient light is crushed—that's normal.
crushed ambient（压掉环境光）
提高对比度，让暗部更扎实。
Raise contrast to solidify the shadows.
solidify the shadows（暗部更扎实）
微调白平衡，对肤色做轻微润色，就可以出片了。
Fine-tune white balance, lightly polish the skin tone—done.
skin tone polish（润色肤色）
scenes.speak: The image looks gray because ambient light is crushed—that's normal. Raise contrast to solidify the shadows. Fine-tune white balance, lightly polish the skin tone—done.

scenes.title_cn: 总结：这个方法的核心是「先黑底、再闪…
scenes.title_en: Summary: the core is black base first, fla…
sentences: 这个方法的核心是先黑底、再闪光。
The core is: black base first, flash second.
black base first（先黑底）
相机负责控制环境光，闪光灯只负责照亮主体。
The camera controls ambient; the flash only lights the subject.
separation of duties（职责分离）
掌握这套思路，你就能举一反三。
Master this split and you can extrapolate.
extrapolate（举一反三）
scenes.speak: The core is: black base first, flash second. The camera controls ambient; the flash only lights the subject. Master this split and you can extrapolate.

practice: Turn on manual, black out the ambient light.
Set TTL and adjust flash compensation.
Raise contrast, fix white balance, polish skin.
pitfalls: Crush the background to black as a baseline.
相机只负责环境光，先压黑。
Judge exposure by the camera screen alone.
Check the flash-lit subject with a test frame.
闪光灯只负责照亮主体。
Raise contrast and polish in post.
偏灰正常，后期三步出片。
This method has a very low bar.
先黑底再闪光，门槛极低。
shifts: 用 TTL（自动测光）、flash compensation（闪光补偿）
用 crush the ambient（压环境光）、black base（黑底）、M mode（M档）
用 raise contrast（提对比）、white balance（白平衡）、polish skin tone（润肤色）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录完整口播。已校正：最好上手、零基础、M档、快门1/200秒、ISO100、f4、白墙测光、黑色画面、TTL、闪光补偿、主体曝光、偏灰、提高对比度、暗部扎实、白平衡、润色肤色、先黑底再闪光、互不干扰、举一反三等。
